ai_summary: AGS Transact Technologies Limited is currently under a Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP), a significant red flag indicating severe financial distress and potential material impacts on its future and stakeholder value. This disclosure, made under Regulation 30, merely announces a minor, one-day re-scheduling of its 19th Committee of Creditors (CoC) meeting, a critical body overseeing the company's potential restructuring or liquidation.
